cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. People at work; each job shows its typical place, clothes and tools so a child can name it.

words.en: Kate has a new job.
words.sz: Kate 找到了一份新工作。
words.scene: Aunt Kate in a smart jacket sitting behind a desk in a bank on her first day, a computer on the desk, a grown-up man colleague shaking her hand and welcoming her.
more: Dad's job is in an office.
爸爸的工作是在办公室里。
Mum loves her job.
妈妈很喜欢她的工作。

words.en: Mum goes to work by bus.
words.sz: 妈妈坐公共汽车去上班。
words.scene: Mum walking to the bus stop early in the morning with her bag, the bus coming along the street, other grown-ups walking to work behind her.
more: Dad works in an office.
爸爸在办公室里工作。
Mum does not work on Sundays.
妈妈星期天不工作。
senses: Mum goes to work by bus.

words.en: That worker wears a hard hat.
words.sz: 那名工人戴着安全帽。
words.scene: Two grown-up men builders in their thirties with beards, hard hats and orange vests carrying bricks on a building site, a crane behind them.
more: Workers build big houses.
工人们建造大房子。
Sam wants to be a worker.
Sam 想当一名工人。

words.en: What is your occupation?
words.sz: 你的职业是什么？
words.scene: A row of four grown-up adults in their work clothes standing side by side: a doctor in a white coat, a cook in a white hat, a police officer in a dark blue uniform and a farmer in boots holding a spade.
more: Being a cook is a busy occupation.
当厨师是很忙的职业。
Lily talks about occupations at school.
Lily 在学校谈论各种职业。

words.en: Dad works in a big office.
words.sz: 爸爸在一间大办公室里工作。
words.scene: Dad sitting at a desk in a bright office, a computer and a lamp on the desk, a plant in the corner and a big window behind him.
more: Kate's office has a big window.
Kate 的办公室有一扇大窗户。
Dad's office is on the third floor.
爸爸的办公室在三楼。

words.en: Sam's dad works for a big company.
words.sz: Sam 的爸爸在一家大公司工作。
words.scene: The hall of a company building with a long desk and a computer on it, grown-ups in smart clothes walking in with their bags, plants and tall glass doors behind.
more: Dad's company has a new office.
爸爸的公司有了新办公室。
The company makes red bicycles.
这家公司制造红色的自行车。

words.en: Grandpa's business is a small shop.
words.sz: 爷爷的生意是一家小商店。
words.scene: Grandpa behind the counter of his small shop, weighing apples into a paper bag for a customer, crates of fruit and vegetables on the shelves behind him.
more: Grandma has a flower business.
奶奶做花卉生意。
The business sells milk and bread.
这家店卖牛奶和面包。

words.en: Mum's boss is very nice.
words.sz: 妈妈的老板人很好。
words.scene: A tall grown-up in a dark suit standing in the door of an office and talking to Dad, who sits at his desk holding papers.
more: The boss talks to Dad in the office.
老板在办公室里和爸爸说话。
Who is the boss of this shop?
这家店的老板是谁？

words.en: The hotel manager says hello to Dad.
words.sz: 酒店经理和爸爸打招呼。
words.scene: a hotel manager in a suit shaking hands with a guest.
more: The manager works in a big hotel.
经理在一家大酒店工作。
The manager gives us a nice room.
经理给了我们一个漂亮的房间。

words.en: The staff at the hotel are kind.
words.sz: 那家酒店的员工很和善。
words.scene: A line of grown-up hotel workers in their twenties to forties, men and women, in matching dark red uniforms standing in a hotel lobby welcoming guests.
more: Grandma knows all the staff here.
奶奶认识这里所有的员工。
The staff at the shop work very hard.
这家商店的员工工作非常努力。

words.en: The businessman carries a big bag.
words.sz: 那位商人提着一个大包。
words.scene: A grown-up man in his forties with short grey hair in a dark suit and tie, walking along a busy city pavement with a briefcase, tall office buildings behind him.
more: That businessman works in a tall building.
那位商人在一栋高楼里工作。
Sam sees the businessman at the hotel.
Sam 在酒店看到那位商人。

words.en: Mum's friend is a businesswoman.
words.sz: 妈妈的朋友是一位商人。
words.scene: a businesswoman in a suit talking on the phone in an office.
more: That businesswoman has a new office.
那位商人有一间新办公室。
The businesswoman talks on the phone.
那位商人在打电话。

words.en: Dad's secretary answers the phone.
words.sz: 爸爸的秘书接电话。
words.scene: A grown-up woman in her thirties in a white blouse at an office desk, answering a telephone and writing in a notebook, a computer beside her.
more: The secretary works in a small office.
秘书在一间小办公室里工作。
Can I see the secretary, please?
我可以见一下秘书吗？

words.en: The receptionist gives Dad the key.
words.sz: 接待员把钥匙给了爸爸。
words.scene: a receptionist at a hotel desk, giving a key to Dad.
more: Ask the receptionist for a room.
向接待员要一个房间。
The receptionist is always nice to guests.
接待员对客人总是很和善。

words.en: Dad has a meeting in the morning.
words.sz: 爸爸上午有个会议。
words.scene: Four grown-ups sitting around a table in a bright office, papers and cups on the table, Mum talking and smiling, a big window behind them.
more: Mum is late for a meeting.
妈妈开会迟到了。
The staff have a meeting every Monday.
员工们每周一开会。

words.en: Dad sits at his desk all morning.
words.sz: 爸爸整个上午都坐在他的书桌前。
more: Mum puts her papers on the desk.
妈妈把她的文件放在书桌上。
There is a lamp on Dad's desk.
爸爸的书桌上有一盏台灯。

words.en: Mum checks her diary for the meeting.
words.sz: 妈妈看看她的日记本，安排会议。
words.scene: Lily sitting at her desk by the window in the soft afternoon light, writing in a small open book with a pencil, one red ribbon lying beside it; no readable writing on the page.
more: Grandma writes in her diary at night.
奶奶晚上写日记。
Lily's diary is on her desk.
Lily 的日记本在她的书桌上。

words.en: Mum reads an email at her desk.
words.sz: 妈妈在她的书桌前看一封电子邮件。
words.scene: Mum sitting at her office desk in front of an open laptop, a big empty envelope floating above the screen, no writing anywhere on the screen, a cup beside her hand.
more: Dad sends an email to the manager.
爸爸发一封电子邮件给经理。
Email Mum when you get home.
到家后给妈妈发电子邮件。
senses: Email Mum when you get home.

words.en: Mum leaves a message for Dad.
words.sz: 妈妈给爸爸留了一条消息。
words.scene: Mum talking on the phone in the kitchen, a big round speech bubble with an empty envelope inside floating beside her head, Tom holding Max by the door.
more: Dad messages Mum at work.
爸爸在工作时给妈妈发消息。
Grandma has a message for Sam.
奶奶有给 Sam 的口信。

words.en: Lily writes a letter to Grandma.
words.sz: Lily 给奶奶写了一封信。
words.scene: Lily putting a letter in a red post box.
more: Dad reads the letter at his desk.
爸爸坐在他的书桌前读信。
Grandma's letter comes on Monday.
奶奶的信星期一寄到。

words.en: Sam earns money by washing cars.
words.sz: Sam 靠洗车挣钱。
words.scene: Sam in an old T-shirt washing a car with a big sponge and a yellow bucket of soapy water, Dad smiling beside him, a few coins in Sam's other hand.
more: Mum works to earn money.
妈妈工作挣钱。
Grandpa does not earn money now.
爷爷现在不挣钱了。

words.en: The doctor works in a big hospital.
words.sz: 那位医生在一所大医院里工作。
words.scene: A kind grown-up man doctor in a white coat sitting at his desk, listening to Tom's chest with a stethoscope, Tom sitting on a high chair with his eyes wide, Mum beside him.
more: That doctor is very kind.
那位医生很和蔼。
Sam wants to be a doctor.
Sam 想当医生。

words.en: Dr Brown works in a hospital.
words.sz: Brown 医生在医院里工作。
words.scene: A friendly grown-up woman doctor in a white coat standing at her door and waving, Lily and Mum walking in with big smiles, a bright waiting room behind the doctor.
more: This is Dr Brown.
这是 Brown 医生。
Mum thanks Dr Brown.
妈妈感谢 Brown 医生。

words.en: The nurse works at night.
words.sz: 那位护士晚上工作。
words.scene: A smiling grown-up nurse in a blue uniform and white cap holding Tom's hand while he sits on a hospital bed, Lily standing on a chair beside her and waving, a small lamp on the wall.
more: A nurse helps the doctor.
护士帮助医生。
Lily's aunt is a nurse.
Lily 的姑妈是护士。

words.en: Our dentist is very friendly.
words.sz: 我们的牙医很友好。
words.scene: Lily sitting in a big green dentist's chair with her mouth open, a smiling grown-up dentist in a white coat leaning over her with a small mirror, Mum standing behind the chair.
more: Mum's friend is a dentist.
妈妈的朋友是牙医。
The dentist looks at Tom's teeth.
牙医看看 Tom 的牙齿。

words.en: The chemist sells medicine.
words.sz: 药店卖药。
words.scene: Mum at the counter of a small shop, the chemist in a white coat handing her a small brown box, tall shelves of bottles and cream jars behind the counter, nothing written anywhere.
more: Grandma talks to the chemist.
奶奶和药剂师说话。
Sam's aunt works at the chemist's.
Sam 的姑妈在药店工作。

words.en: Lily's teacher works at our school.
words.sz: Lily 的老师在我们学校工作。
more: Mia's mum is a teacher.
Mia 的妈妈是老师。
Grandpa was a teacher.
爷爷以前是老师。

words.en: Sam is a good student at school.
words.sz: Sam 在学校是个好学生。
more: Our class has twenty students.
我们班有二十个学生。
Tom wants to be a student.
Tom 想当学生。

words.en: The cook makes us a big breakfast.
words.sz: 厨师给我们做一顿大早餐。
more: Dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
爸爸星期天做晚饭。
Can you cook eggs, Tom?
Tom，你会煮鸡蛋吗？

words.en: Tom's uncle is a waiter.
words.sz: Tom 的叔叔是服务员。
more: The waiter works in a busy restaurant.
那位服务员在一家繁忙的餐馆工作。
The waiter brings us our drinks.
服务员给我们端来饮料。

words.en: Mia's mum is a waitress.
words.sz: Mia 的妈妈是女服务员。
more: The waitress works in a cafe.
那位女服务员在咖啡馆工作。
The waitress takes the cups to the kitchen.
女服务员把杯子拿到厨房。

words.en: The cleaner works at our school.
words.sz: 清洁工在我们学校工作。
words.scene: A grown-up woman in her fifties in a blue cleaner's uniform mopping the floor of a school corridor, a yellow bucket beside her.
more: The cleaner cleans the floor.
清洁工打扫地板。
Lily says thank you to the cleaner.
Lily 对清洁工说谢谢。

words.en: The shop assistant helps Mum.
words.sz: 店员帮了妈妈。
words.scene: A grown-up young woman shop assistant in her twenties with a name badge folding t-shirts on a table in a clothes shop, colourful clothes on rails behind her.
more: The shop assistant sells T-shirts.
店员卖T恤。
Grandma talks to the shop assistant.
奶奶和店员说话。

words.en: That customer buys apples every week.
words.sz: 那位顾客每周都买苹果。
words.scene: A grown-up man customer in a coat paying with coins at a café counter, a grown-up woman behind the counter handing him a cup of coffee.
more: The shop assistant thanks the customer.
店员感谢那位顾客。
There are many customers on Saturday.
星期六有很多顾客。

words.en: The shoppers carry many bags.
words.sz: 购物者们提着很多袋子。
words.scene: shoppers with many bags in a busy shopping street.
more: Every shopper has a big red bag.
每位购物者都有一个红色的大袋子。
The shoppers walk slowly along the street.
购物者们沿着街道慢慢走。

words.en: The hotel has a new guest today.
words.sz: 旅馆今天来了一位新客人。
more: Grandpa is our guest tonight.
爷爷今晚是我们的客人。
Every guest gets a cup of tea.
每位客人都有一杯茶。

words.en: A police officer helps us cross the road.
words.sz: 一位警察帮我们过马路。
words.scene: A tall grown-up police officer in his thirties in a dark blue uniform and hat holding up one hand to stop the cars, helping Tom cross the road at a zebra crossing.
more: The police officer says hello to Tom.
那位警察和 Tom 打招呼。
Sam wants to be a police officer.
Sam 想当警察。

words.en: Sam's uncle is a bus driver.
words.sz: Sam 的叔叔是公交车司机。
words.scene: A grown-up man bus driver in his forties with a moustache and a blue uniform shirt sitting at the big steering wheel of a bus, passengers sitting behind him.
more: The driver works every morning.
那位司机每天早上工作。
Grandpa was a taxi driver.
爷爷以前是出租车司机。

words.en: Mum's friend is a pilot.
words.sz: 妈妈的朋友是飞行员。
words.scene: A grown-up woman pilot in her thirties in a dark blue uniform with gold stripes and a pilot's cap sitting in a plane cockpit with many buttons, clouds outside the window.
more: The pilot talks to us on the plane.
飞行员在飞机上和我们说话。
The pilot wears a blue cap.
飞行员戴蓝色的帽子。

words.en: The mechanic works in a garage.
words.sz: 修理工在车库里工作。
words.scene: A grown-up man mechanic in his thirties in blue overalls with oil on his hands, kneeling and changing a car wheel in a garage, tools on the floor.
more: Dad talks to the mechanic.
爸爸和修理工说话。
The mechanic changes our car wheel.
修理工给我们换汽车轮子。

words.en: The engineer checks the new bridge.
words.sz: 工程师检查那座新桥。
words.scene: A tall grown-up woman engineer about forty years old with grey streaks in her hair, in a white hard hat and an orange vest, standing on a big new bridge and checking a large plan; workers behind her.
more: Dad's sister is an engineer.
爸爸的姐妹是工程师。
The engineer wears a hard hat.
工程师戴安全帽。

words.en: The farmer gets up early every morning.
words.sz: 那位农民每天早上早早起床。
words.scene: A grown-up man farmer in his fifties in a flat cap and boots driving a red tractor in a green field, cows behind a fence.
more: The farmer has cows and sheep.
那位农民有奶牛和绵羊。
Sam talks to the farmer at the gate.
Sam 在门口和农民说话。

words.en: Grandpa has a big farm.
words.sz: 爷爷有一个大农场。
words.scene: A big farm with a white farmhouse and a red barn, cows and sheep in the green field, a tractor and low hills behind.
more: We visit Grandpa's farm on Saturday.
我们星期六去爷爷的农场。
The milk comes from this farm.
这些牛奶来自这个农场。

words.en: Mia's dad works in a toy factory.
words.sz: Mia 的爸爸在一家玩具厂工作。
words.scene: a big factory with machines making toy cars.
more: This factory makes toy cars.
这家工厂生产玩具汽车。
The factory is near the river.
工厂在河边。

words.en: That actor is on television.
words.sz: 那名演员在电视上。
words.scene: A grown-up man actor in his thirties dressed as a pirate with a big black hat and a sword, speaking on a theatre stage with red curtains, people watching.
more: The actor wears a funny hat.
那位演员戴一顶滑稽的帽子。
Lily wants to be an actor.
Lily 想当一名演员。

words.en: The artist paints beautiful pictures.
words.sz: 那位画家画漂亮的图画。
words.scene: A grown-up woman artist in her forties with grey-streaked hair and a paint-covered apron painting a big landscape picture on an easel in a sunny studio.
more: That artist works in a small room.
那位画家在一个小房间里工作。
Sam likes this artist's pictures.
Sam 喜欢这位画家的图画。

words.en: The painter paints the kitchen wall.
words.sz: 油漆工粉刷厨房的墙。
words.scene: A grown-up man painter in his forties in white overalls with paint spots, standing on a ladder painting a kitchen wall yellow with a long roller.
more: The painter wears old clothes.
那位油漆工穿着旧衣服。
Dad asks the painter to paint the door.
爸爸请油漆工油漆门。

words.en: The musician plays the violin.
words.sz: 那位乐手拉小提琴。
words.scene: A grown-up woman musician playing the violin on a small stage under warm lights, a music stand in front of her, her eyes closed.
more: Mia's brother is a musician.
Mia 的哥哥是音乐家。
That musician works in a theatre.
那位音乐家在剧院里工作。

words.en: The singer sings very well.
words.sz: 那位歌手唱得很好。
words.scene: A grown-up woman singer in her twenties in a sparkly dress singing into a microphone on a stage, bright lights above her, people watching.
more: Mia's sister wants to be a singer.
Mia 的姐姐想当歌手。
That singer has a small microphone.
那位歌手有一个小话筒。

words.en: The photographer takes our photo.
words.sz: 那位摄影师给我们拍照。
words.scene: a photographer with a big camera taking a family photo.
more: Mum asks the photographer to help.
妈妈请摄影师帮忙。
The photographer has a new camera.
那位摄影师有一台新相机。

words.en: The writer writes stories for children.
words.sz: 那位作家给孩子们写故事。
words.scene: A grown-up woman writer in her fifties with glasses sitting at a desk full of books, writing a story in a big notebook with a pen, a cup of tea beside her.
more: Grandma reads a book by that writer.
奶奶读那位作家写的一本书。
Sam wants to be a writer.
Sam 想当一位作家。

words.en: The journalist writes for a newspaper.
words.sz: 那位记者为报纸写稿。
words.scene: A grown-up woman journalist in her thirties holding out a microphone and a notebook to a grown-up footballer in a football kit after a match.
more: That journalist asks Dad questions.
那位记者问爸爸问题。
The journalist works in a busy office.
那位记者在一间繁忙的办公室里工作。

words.en: The explorer works in cold places.
words.sz: 那位探险家在寒冷的地方工作。
more: Grandpa reads books about explorers.
爷爷读关于探险家的书。
That explorer has a big map.
那位探险家有一张大地图。

words.en: That footballer is very fast.
words.sz: 那名足球运动员跑得很快。
words.scene: A grown-up man footballer in his twenties in a red football kit kicking the ball hard on a big green pitch in a stadium full of fans.
more: Sam watches the footballer play.
Sam 看那名足球运动员踢球。
Lily's uncle is a famous footballer.
Lily 的叔叔是著名的足球运动员。

words.en: Dad's friend is a football player.
words.sz: 爸爸的朋友是足球运动员。
more: That football player plays every Saturday.
那名足球运动员每星期六都踢球。
Sam talks to the football player.
Sam 和那名足球运动员说话。

words.en: Sam's aunt is a tennis player.
words.sz: Sam 的姑妈是网球运动员。
more: The tennis player practises every morning.
那名网球运动员每天早上练习。
Lily watches the tennis player on television.
Lily 在电视上看那名网球运动员。

words.en: The coach teaches us football.
words.sz: 教练教我们踢足球。
more: Our coach wears a blue jacket.
我们的教练穿一件蓝色夹克。
The coach helps Sam play better.
教练帮 Sam 踢得更好。

words.en: The guide knows the hill well.
words.sz: 那位向导很熟悉那座小山。
words.scene: a mountain guide leading the family up a hill path.
more: That guide works in the mountains.
那位向导在山区工作。
Ask the guide before we walk.
我们走之前先问一下向导。

words.en: The tour guide talks to us.
words.sz: 那位导游和我们说话。
words.scene: a tour guide holding up a small flag, leading a group of tourists past an old castle.
more: Our tour guide knows the castle.
我们的导游熟悉那座城堡。
That tour guide works in a big city.
那位导游在一个大城市工作。

words.en: The king wears a long red coat.
words.sz: 那位国王穿着一件红色的长外套。
words.scene: A fairy-tale king with a golden crown and a long red coat, sitting on a tall seat in a stone hall and smiling.
more: Grandma reads a story about a kind king.
奶奶读一个关于善良国王的故事。
The king has a tall hat.
国王有一顶高帽子。

words.en: The queen wears a long dress.
words.sz: 女王穿着一条长裙。
words.scene: A fairy-tale queen, a grown-up woman in her fifties with grey hair, a golden crown and a long purple dress with a fur cape, sitting on a golden throne in a castle hall.
more: Grandma reads a story about a queen.
奶奶读一个关于女王的故事。
That queen is kind to her people.
那位女王对她的子民很好。

words.en: Nurses wear a white uniform.
words.sz: 护士穿白色的制服。
more: Dad's work uniform is blue.
爸爸的工作制服是蓝色的。
The driver puts on his uniform.
那位司机穿上他的制服。

words.en: The cook follows the instructions.
words.sz: 厨师照着说明做。
more: Ask the guide for instructions.
向导游询问指示。
The instructions are easy to read.
这些说明很容易读。

words.en: Mum got her diploma at college.
words.sz: 妈妈在大学拿到了文凭。
more: The doctor shows us her diploma.
那位医生给我们看她的文凭。
Dad's diploma is on the wall.
爸爸的文凭挂在墙上。

words.en: The writer works on a computer.
words.sz: 那位作家在电脑上工作。
more: Mum sends emails on the computer.
妈妈用电脑发电子邮件。
The shop assistant uses two computers.
那位店员用两台电脑。

words.en: Take a break if you feel tired.
words.sz: 如果觉得累，就休息一下。
more: Mum has a break at eleven.
妈妈十一点休息一下。
Sit down and have a break, Grandpa.
坐下休息一下吧，爷爷。
